answer: Before an identity may answer, it must solve a fresh proof-of-work puzzle bound to the epoch seed and its own key, taking about 40 seconds of CPU per identity. A farm of 900 fakes pays 600 CPU-minutes every epoch plus power, while one honest agent pays once, so cloning stops scaling. Without terrace the panel is blind, without raven the farm is free, and without shale nobody can prove what happened.
